addr: Ground Floor, No 39, 80 Feet Rd, opposite 12th Main Road, Hal, HAL 3rd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560075, India

rev.t:
Right at KFC square. Finding parking may be a challenge.
Good collection of books. Place is not very big though. Staff is helpful.

Cute cozy bookstore :)
Loved their Blind Book Date section- Thanks to it, I ended up discovering a real gem of a book that I might never have picked otherwise ❤️
This bookshop is wonderful with a wide variety of collections! It's a cozy haven for all bookworms, and you'll find yourself lost among the many great reads. Highly recommend for any book lover!
